## Checklist

- [ ] The title is a conventional commit (`feat: …`, `fix: …`, `docs: …`)
- [ ] `dotnet build` has no warnings and `dotnet test` is green
- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests (contract tests for adapters)
- [ ] Design decisions have a short ADR in `docs/adr`
